children: Frankfurt am Main, September 09, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has today upgraded the ratings of 3 notes in BBVA RMBS 1, FTA, BBVA RMBS 2, FTA and BBVA RMBS 14 Fondo de Titulizacion de Activos. The notes are backed by residential mortgage loan contracts originated and serviced by Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A.. We affirmed the ratings of the notes that had sufficient credit enhancement to maintain their current ratings.

title: Moody's Ratings upgrades ratings in three Spanish BBVA RMBS transactions
